title: The Ultimate Ancient city of Ayutthaya Private Day Trip
overview: Visit the ancient home of the Siamese kings on a full-day, private tour from Bangkok to Ayutthaya, a former imperial capital and UNESCO World Heritage Site. See the ornate Bang Pa-In, or Summer Palace, a Buddha image in a Bodhi tree, and historic temple complexes, then take a slow boat ride around Ayutthaya island. This private tour includes all activities and round-trip transport from centrally-located Bangkok hotels.
inclusions: Hotel pickup and drop-off in Bangkok
startDescription: The host picks up at the booked Bangkok hotel or a confirmed central meeting point in Bangkok.
highlights: Private eight-hour Ayutthaya day from Bangkok hotels
Bang Pa-In Summer Palace and Wat Phra Sri Sanphet
Wat Mahathat Buddha head in a bodhi tree
Boat circuit around Ayutthaya island
Quieter stop at Wat Worachettharam

title: Private Tour: Best of Bangkok in A Day
overview: Discover the best that Bangkok has to offer on this full-day private tour of the city. Visit all of the must-see attractions such as the Grand Palace, Chinatown, the vibrant flower market, Wat Pho, Wat Arun, and much more. Learn about the city’s rich history, religion, and culture from your informative guide as you drive around Bangkok in a comfortable, air-conditioned vehicle.
inclusions: Hotel pickup and drop-off in Bangkok city center
startDescription: The guide meets the group at 8:00 a.m. in the booked Bangkok hotel lobby.
highlights: Private eight-hour Bangkok city circuit
Grand Palace, Wat Pho, and Wat Arun
Chinatown and the flower market
Licensed local guide and air-conditioned vehicle
Hotel pickup in Bangkok city center

title: Private Half-Day Bangkok City Tour with The Grand Palace
overview: Make the most of your time in Bangkok with a private half-day tour to the Thai capital’s most important temples and palaces. The sprawling city can be overwhelming to navigate, but a personal driver and guide takes the stress out of getting around so you can easily fit in stops at the Grand Palace, Wat Pho, Wat Arun, and other must-see landmarks.
startDescription: Hotel pickup in Bangkok is confirmed when booking.
highlights: Private four-hour Bangkok temple circuit
Grand Palace, Wat Pho, and Wat Arun
Personal driver and guide
Hotel pickup in Bangkok
Half-day pacing instead of a full-day market add-on

title: Floating Market Damnoen Saduak and Meklong Railway Market: Half Day Tour
overview: Escape the bustling city of Bangkok on this half-day tour to the Maeklong and floating markets. Canoe through the floating markets and see vendors selling everything from fresh produce to everyday items. Get your heart pumping as you continue to the Maeklong Railway Market where vendors sell their goods, and quickly pack them up, along this active railway line.
startDescription: Hotel pickup from a Bangkok city hotel is confirmed when booking.
highlights: Private half-day market outing from Bangkok
Damnoen Saduak Floating Market by paddle boat
Maeklong Railway Market on an active track
Private vehicle and local guide
Hotel pickup and drop-off in Bangkok

title: Silom Thai Cooking School with Market Tour
overview: Learn to make five classic Thai dishes with your choice of a morning, afternoon, or evening cooking class in Bangkok. The morning tour also includes a guided visit to the local market, where you see typical ingredients that go into Thai cuisine. You'll then work with your instructor to prepare dishes such as pad thai and tom yum, before sitting down to enjoy the meal that you helped to create.
inclusions: Meal of the dishes prepared in class
Fresh local market visit on morning classes
startDescription: Meet at Silom Thai Cooking School on Soi Decho near Chong Nonsi BTS, as listed when booking.
highlights: Three-hour cooking class in Silom, Bangkok
Five classic Thai dishes such as pad thai and tom yum
Morning option includes a local market visit
Recipe book to take home
Meal of the dishes prepared in class

title: Bangkok Hidden Gems: Talad Noi, Chinatown & Street Food Tour
overview: Explore Bangkok’s trendy Talad Noi neighborhood and Chinatown on a small-group walking tour and sample delicious Thai and Chinese street food along the way. Stroll past a historic church and shrine, market stalls, find plenty of bargains, and admire local street art. The perfect introduction to the area for first time visitors.
inclusions: Walking route through Talad Noi and Chinatown
startDescription: Meet the guide at Si Phraya - Chao Phraya Express Pier / River City Bangkok, as listed when booking.
highlights: Small-group walk through Talad Noi and Chinatown
Holy Rosary Church and Chow Sue Kong Shrine
Thai and Chinese street-food tastings
Wat Mangkon Kamalawat
Meet at Si Phraya pier in Bangkok

title: Tingly Thai Cooking Class with Morning Market Tour
overview: Discover the art of Thai cuisine with a cooking class and market tour in Bangkok. Your chef-instructor shows you commonly used ingredients at the local market. Then, return to the cooking school for a hands-on class that covers food preparation techniques and the steps to making several popular recipes. The class wraps up with a delicious lunch of the dishes that you helped to create.
inclusions: Meal of the dishes prepared in class
startDescription: Meet at the confirmed Tingly Thai Cooking School address in Bangkok listed when booking.
highlights: Three-and-a-half-hour cooking class in Bangkok
Guided morning market ingredient walk
Hands-on recipes such as tom yum, pad thai, green curry, and mango sticky rice
Small-group chef instruction
Lunch of the dishes prepared in class

title: Bangkok Canal Tour: 2-Hour Longtail Boat Ride
overview: See a side of Bangkok that most travelers don’t get to see as you cruise along the canals of Thonburi. Set sail along the klong of the Chao Phraya River in a traditional longtail boat and enjoy a glimpse of local life in the Thonburi district of Bangkok. Enjoy up to two hours on the water and stop to visit Baan Silapin (The Artist’s House) and Wat Paknam Phasi Charoen.
startDescription: Meet the licensed English-speaking guide near Wat Pho and walk with the group to board the longtail boat.
highlights: Two-hour longtail boat ride on Thonburi canals
Baan Silapin Artist House stop
Photo pause at Wat Paknam Phasi Charoen
Licensed English-speaking guide
Meet near Wat Pho in Bangkok

title: Bangkok: Backstreets and Temple Historic Bike Tour
overview: Hit Bangkok’s back streets and explore the city with ease on two wheels. This half-day guided bike tour takes you off the main tourist beat and introduces you to a Bangkok few visitors have seen. Ride through local neighborhoods and across the Rama 8 Bridge, and suss out some of the city’s most mouthwatering street foods en route. Along the way, your guide also fills you in on local history.
startDescription: Meet at Discova Day Tour Shop Bangkok, 719 Maha Chai Road, Wang Burapha Phirom, Phra Nakhon, as listed when booking.
highlights: Four-hour small-group bike ride in historic Bangkok
Phra Nakhon backstreets and local neighborhoods
Rama 8 Bridge crossing
Chao Phraya River ferry segment
Bike, helmet, snacks, and guide included

title: Half-Day Railway Market and Floating Market Tour in Thailand
overview: Experience two of Bangkok’s most famous traditional markets on this half-day tour. Benefit from a small group size as you ride the train to the Maeklong Railway Market, uniquely situated on a working railway track. After free time for shopping, continue to the Damnoen Saduak Floating Market and cruise around the stalls on a longtail boat.
inclusions: Train segment to Mae Klong Railway Market
Boat circuit at Damnoen Saduak Floating Market
startDescription: Hotel pickup in Bangkok is confirmed when booking. The outing ends at MBK Center.
highlights: Small-group market day from Bangkok
Mae Klong Railway Market on an active track
Damnoen Saduak Floating Market boat circuit
Hotel pickup in Bangkok
Drop-off at MBK Center
